title: UI风格#98 - Victorian Library (维多利亚图书馆)
description: 创建第98种UI风格：维多利亚图书馆风格 - 深色木质、皮革装订、黄铜点缀。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCT.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Library style When color palette Then features mahogany brown, leather tan, aged cream, brass gold
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#4A0E0E (红木), #D2B48C (皮革), #FFF8DC (奶油), #B8860B (黄铜), #2F1810 (深褐)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Library style When typography Then uses Victorian fonts: Playfair Display, Crimson Text, or EB Garamond
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Playfair Display (标题), Crimson Text (正文), EB Garamond (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Library style When layout Then book spines, library ladders, card catalog drawers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：书脊阵列、图书馆梯子、卡片目录、橡木书架

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Library style When UI elements Then leather textures, brass accents, book page edges
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：皮革质感、黄铜点缀、书页边缘、翻页动画

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Library UI When functional Then includes scholarly chat, librarian agents, archive stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：学术聊天、图书管理员代理、档案统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Victorian Library UI When copy Then uses scholarly language: 'Archive', 'Scholar', 'Volume', 'Knowledge'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'ARCHIVE. SCHOLAR. VOLUME.'、按钮'SEND'→'RESEARCH'、'SUBMIT'→'CATALOG'
